frozen.providerPolicy: public settings fixture only; same fixture policy across modes

flexible.traceMeasurementNote: observedResolverExtractionBudgetCounter is the maximum of emitted cumulative counter snapshots, not a physical extractor or HTTP request count; zero snapshots do not mean no extraction when logical extraction_start events are present. Shared lookup events are joined only when one native operation owns the lookup; ambiguous consumers are left unassigned.

note: Failures remain in attempt denominators; p95 is withheld unless >=20 measured timing samples. Trace fields count allowlisted logical events and resolver extraction-budget use only; they do not represent HTTP request totals. Concurrent phase duration samples are not additive. Per-attempt RSS is omitted because available child RSS is a lifetime high-water mark. Trace reparse correlates allowlisted logical events by native operation ID, with unique shared-lookup fallback for ID-less events. Logical extraction-start events are separate from observed budget-counter snapshots; neither is an HTTP request count.

traceReparse.source: retained owner-only diagnostic report and stderr log
